title: Twenty-five flyers
logline: The Crab Derby: the wall at twenty-five, the girl, twelve, on tiptoe pinning, and at the page's edge a shoulder in plaid holding the tin of pins. He's in the page as a shoulder and a hand with a tin.

panels.composition: The shingle wall with twenty-five flyers, a twelve-year-old girl on tiptoe pinning the newest, and at the left edge a man's shoulder in plaid and a hand holding out a small tin of pushpins.

characters.pose: a shoulder and a hand with a tin

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a shingle wall with a row of twenty-five crab flyers where a twelve-year-old girl on tiptoe pins the newest, a man's plaid shoulder and hand holding a tin of pushpins entering at the page's left edge, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Twenty-five. A hand with a tin.
